code: import axios from"axios";const BASE=process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL;export const API_BASE="".concat(BASE,"/api");export const api=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE});api.interceptors.request.use(cfg=>{const t=localStorage.getItem("careai_token");if(t)cfg.headers.Authorization="Bearer ".concat(t);return cfg;});export function setToken(t){if(t)localStorage.setItem("careai_token",t);else localStorage.removeItem("careai_token");}export function getToken(){return localStorage.getItem("careai_token");}
